regions.label: 연필 숲

floor.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One standalone 2D game terrain sprite, square, ultimately 256x256 pixels. Serious atmospheric non-pixel metroidvania Unfin. This is a production material illustration, NOT a scenic picture, NOT a tile sheet, NOT a cube.
ART DIRECTION: user describes earlier reference as realism90/100; new target is75/100. Noticeably painterly, stylized game art with deliberate clean planes and sweeping material motifs. Preserve rich material character but REDUCE photorealism: no photographic scans, no micro-grain, no photorealistic surface pores, no dense speckling, no raytraced glossy rendering. Approximately 25 percent simplification of small details into broader brush-shaped forms, selective medium cracks. NOT cute, NOT flat childish vector blobs. Major motifs about20percent larger than prior reference; fewer larger structural forms, not more microtexture. The reference is MATERIAL IDENTITY ONLY: redraw its rendering and orientation.
OPAQUE DARK INTERIOR: only the first 8 percent depth from exposed edge has clear texture, rapid tonal falloff between8 and24percent, beyond25percent is almost uniform near-black #090B10 with only1percent residual detail. Dark mass must remain opaque. No illumination on far joining sides. No spotlights, fog, glow or cast shadows. Depth is conveyed by layer design, not perspective.
GEOMETRY: strictly orthographic flat side elevation, camera perfectly perpendicular to the cross-section. ZERO visible top-facing planes, ZERO perspective thickness, ZERO receding edges, ZERO isometric or bevel-cube look. Fill the square to every edge with solid material. No backdrop, air gaps, transparent margins, border frame, labels or text. No rounded canvas corners. Exposed edge perfectly straight continuous. Only the exposed edge is defined; other3edges crop through material without framing or outlines. Joining ends should have the same material values and contour thickness, with no distinctive crossing pattern. Smooth anti-aliasing, no pixels or dithering.
MATERIAL: Petrified graphite roots with broad tapering woody ribs embedded in angular charcoal mineral. One or two large flowing root gestures, a few simplified bark grooves, sparse oblique graphite facets. No fine root hairs or mineral grains. Almost monochrome slate #41454F #5E6168, outline #25272C, modest ash-grey edges.
FLOOR BODY. Exposed edge at TOP y=0. Solid earth fills entire image BELOW. Draw ONLY the vertical front cross-section meeting the upper canvas edge, absolutely NO visible upper horizontal plane or floor top surface. All strata lie in this frontal picture plane. The game export will add a separate EXACTLY FOUR PIXEL horizontal surface strip, so DO NOT invent a wide top slab, trapezoid, receding top depth, or diagonal perspective. Topmost visible front-face material can have worn detail but no upward-facing paving. Preserve darkness below the edge as specified. Fresh illustration with the new75/100 style.
